name: Do I need to move out during a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not always strictly necessary, many homeowners find it beneficial to temporarily relocate during a whole-home renovation, especially for projects involving extensive structural changes, kitchen and bathroom demolition, or significant dust and noise. This can significantly improve the homeowner experience and allow our team to work more efficiently without interruption. AKN Design Group can discuss the specific demands of your project during the planning phase to help you determine the most practical approach for your family's comfort and the project's timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Relocating during a whole-home renovation can improve efficiency and homeowner comfort, particularly for extensive projects involving structural changes or demolition.
